lifts.said: I built the New order screen at /new. It has the item (Masala chai), the cups (one, two or three, with two chosen to start), the New order amount (₹30.00 for two cups at 1,500 paise a cup), and a Take the order button that doesn't save anything yet.
I built the staff screen Today's total at /total. It shows Today's takings (₹113.00 for the sample day) and GST on today's takings (₹5.65, five percent rounded to the paisa).
